category_title: Students seeking individual academic assistance to compensate for home limitations
minimal_context: The student is meeting with the teacher before the morning bell to get help with a homework assignment.
dialogue:
TUTOR: It is almost time for class. Here is the homework assignment.

STUDENT: I have a question about something I do not understand in the homework. I came to your office so you could help me understand the problem.

TUTOR: Just read the instructions again. What do you think the answer is?

STUDENT: I need someone who helps me to do the homework, like those I do not understand. The bell rings at 8:15 a.m. and I want to have the homework ready when I go to class.

TUTOR: Keep trying on your own. I need to finish checking these other papers right now.

STUDENT: (Puts the homework away) I need extra assistance because my parents cannot help me at home due to their language limitations. If you will not provide extra instruction, I will just leave.

options.A: Reduce the amount of redundant homework assigned to the student to complete outside of regular class time.
options.B: Adapt the interactional style when working with the student rather than treating them in the same way as mainstream students.
options.C: Make a pictorial description of the homework problems to help the student understand the assignment during the morning session.
options.D: Use a visual schedule that identifies the morning activities and the reinforcers the student is eligible to receive for contingent performance.
